name: 香草甜甜
evolution: 脆筒甜甜 → 香草甜甜 Lv.28 → 圣代甜甜 Lv.40
description: 香草甜甜一族口感各有不同，头上顶着的果果是身体的一部分，拥有360度的视野。因果果吸收不同能量而演化出不同口感分支，身体散发着浓郁的奶香。
descriptionEn: The Xiangcaotiantian family has different tastes; the fruit on its head is part of its body and has a 360-degree field of view. Different energy absorbed by the fruit evolves into different taste branches, and its body emits a rich milky fragrance.

skills.name: 风吹雪
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, restores 1 energy to self.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Damage reduction 70%, responding to an attack.

skills.name: 寒风吹
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得魔防-50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; enemy gains Magic Defense -50%.

skills.name: 暴风雪
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得1层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains 1 Freeze mark.

skills.name: 雾气环绕
skills.description: 回复能量，回复值等于敌方技能总能耗的一半。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores energy equal to half of the total energy cost of the enemy's skills.

skills.name: 冰晶坠
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains all skills' energy cost +1.

skills.name: 霜天
skills.description: 敌方获得1层冻结，且每有1层冻结获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 1 Freeze mark, and for each Freeze mark gains all skills' energy cost +1.

skills.name: 碎冰冰
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层冻结，本次技能威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each Freeze mark the enemy has, this skill's power +20.

skills.name: 冰点
skills.description: 敌方获得5层冻结，应对防御：额外获得5层。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 5 Freeze marks; when responding to defense: additionally gains 5.

skills.name: 冰锋横扫
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能威力等于敌方精灵技能总能耗的10倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; this skill's power equals 10 times the total energy cost of the enemy's skills.

skills.name: 冰雹
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外使敌方获得全技能能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when responding to a status: additionally makes enemy gain all skills' energy cost +3.

skills.name: 极寒领域
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若敌方有冻结，本次技能威力+60，应对状态：使冻结翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if enemy has Freeze, this skill's power +60; when responding to a status: doubles Freeze.
